doc.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018

title: What making it means
summary: Making it means doing what you want and getting paid, accepting compromises.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: It’s always a weaving path for musicians. Do you have an idea of what it means for yourself to “make it” in the music business?

Well you know for me making it is doing what you want and getting paid. Not just doing what you want and not getting paid. So — because we could do that. I could do that until the end of time in my living room, but yeah, being able to do things that you enjoy and making a living from it. And you make compromises and that’s okay. That’s what life is about you know. So you know I have some different things that I do and over time you come to accept where the music is taking you.
